west_road_competence_evidence.observation: Fresh withdrawal prints lead toward the low rise; two trampled patches overlook the same road stretch.
west_road_competence_evidence.outdoor_tracking: You recognize directional heel-to-toe impressions in the fresh prints; a direction alone does not establish the complete route.
west_road_competence_evidence.surveillance_analysis: You recognize overlapping sightlines from the two trampled positions; the link between them still needs investigation.
west_road_competence_evidence.tactical_assessment: You can divide the committed guards between the two nearby positions, reducing a guarded survey to one hour.

discovery_declarations.title: Local Withdrawal Direction
discovery_declarations.text: Fresh prints leave the wagon path toward the low rise. This supports only a local direction; the complete route remains unconfirmed.

discovery_declarations.title: Overlapping Watch Positions
discovery_declarations.text: Two trampled patches overlook the same road stretch. Their overlap supports a local observation circuit, but its complete route remains unconfirmed.

discovery_declarations.title: Repeated Watch Tracks
discovery_declarations.text: Repeated boot and animal tracks lie away from the traffic path, where several people could watch passing wagons. They suggest deliberate observation, not identity or an attack.

discovery_declarations.title: Mara's Account
discovery_declarations.text: Mara reports seeing two observers ahead and taking her caravan off the road. Her caravan survived the delay; she could not identify the observers.

discovery_declarations.title: Patrol Timing Marks
discovery_declarations.text: Repeated marks correspond to watch changes. Combined with the tracks, they support an inference of organized preparation; they do not identify the group.

discovery_declarations.title: Escaped Driver Report
discovery_declarations.text: An escaped driver reports that a second wagon was intercepted during your investigation. The attackers questioned its supply-stop destination; that stop may be their next target.

discovery_declarations.title: Withdrawal Route
discovery_declarations.text: Fresh signs lead to an abandoned lookout beside the local road. You have found a withdrawal route, but captured nobody.

discovery_declarations.title: Likely Staging Area
discovery_declarations.text: Nearby tracks converge on a sheltered hollow with fresh wagon-handling marks. It is a likely staging area, not proof of who occupies it.

pressure_observation_cue.text: The cold has become noticeably more severe.

west_road_predicament.premise: West-road travelers report being watched, and one caravan is overdue. Grey suspects organized raiders; Elin wants specific evidence before diverting patrols. The caravan may have been delayed rather than destroyed.

phase_text.investigating: Grey fears a developing threat to trade. Elin will not divert limited guards on rumor alone. Investigate the Southwest Trade Road, speak with Mara, then report both findings to Elin at the North Gate. Acting may alert the observers and divert coverage; waiting leaves traffic exposed.
phase_text.observers_withdrew: You advocated immediate patrol action. After one hour, guards disrupted the observers, who withdrew and left fresh signs. Grey considers intervention justified; Elin notes the cost to other coverage. Choose: pursue observers, or restore coverage.
phase_text.wagon_intercepted: You chose one more hour of investigation while normal coverage remained. You found patrol-timing signs, but another wagon was intercepted. Its escaped driver identified a threatened supply stop. Elin understands your restraint; Grey regrets the delay. Choose: protect supply stop, or locate raiders.
phase_text.withdrawal_route_found: You pursued local signs and found the withdrawal route. Road-focused patrol coverage remains extended; other approaches have fewer guards. Nobody was captured. The broader threat remains unresolved.
phase_text.coverage_restored: You restored ordinary local coverage. Other approaches are protected again, but the withdrawal route remains unexplored and the observers unlocated. The broader threat remains unresolved.
phase_text.supply_stop_protected: You warned the supply stop and arranged protection. Its next departure is held safely, but the raiders remain unlocated. The broader threat remains unresolved.
phase_text.raider_staging_area_found: You investigated nearby signs and found a likely staging area without confrontation. The supply stop has no dedicated protection. The broader threat remains unresolved.

captain_darvin_grey.investigating: We need credible information before a threat to trade grows. Tracks alone cannot prove a raid.
captain_darvin_grey.observers_withdrew: Your patrol broke up the watchers. We should learn where they went, but Elin must weigh the cost of keeping guards away.
captain_darvin_grey.wagon_intercepted: Your caution brought stronger information, but another driver paid for the delay. We must choose protection or a local search.
captain_darvin_grey.withdrawal_route_found: The withdrawal route gives us useful information. We have not eliminated the threat.
captain_darvin_grey.coverage_restored: Normal coverage is restored. I remain concerned about the observers we did not follow.
captain_darvin_grey.supply_stop_protected: The next departure is protected. We still do not know where the raiders are.
captain_darvin_grey.raider_staging_area_found: A likely staging area is useful intelligence. The supply stop still needs protection.

guard_elin_voss.investigating: Bring me the tracks and the merchant account. Immediate patrols cost other coverage; further investigation takes an hour while traffic remains exposed.
guard_elin_voss.observers_withdrew: I committed guards because you advocated action on credible but incomplete evidence. Do we follow the signs or restore coverage?
guard_elin_voss.wagon_intercepted: Your request for better evidence was reasonable. Normal coverage stayed in place, but the interception now forces another decision.
guard_elin_voss.withdrawal_route_found: We followed the local trail without a confrontation. Road coverage remains extended.
guard_elin_voss.coverage_restored: Our guards are back on ordinary coverage. We left the withdrawal trail unexamined.
guard_elin_voss.supply_stop_protected: The supply stop has been warned and its next departure held safely.
guard_elin_voss.raider_staging_area_found: We found a likely staging area without a confrontation. No dedicated guards protect the supply stop.
